description:
List incidents (confirmed outages), newest first.

status: ongoing (still open), resolved, acknowledged, suppressed, or all. Returns {items: Incident[], total, page, page_size, counts} where each Incident has id, monitor_id, monitor_name, started_at, resolved_at, duration_seconds, confirming_region_names, acknowledged_at, alert_suppressed, is_flapping.

from.description: ISO-8601: incidents started at or after this time

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (readable summary) or 'json' (full structured data)

to.description: ISO-8601: incidents started at or before this time

name: sutramx_list_incidents
title: List incidents
